title: Filesystem scan spams `update_scripts_classes` messages
body:
### Tested versions

Godot Engine v4.5.beta5.official.c81fd6c51

### System information

GitHub workflow on ubuntu-24.04 

### Issue description

I need to rebuild the Godot cache in the CI workflow so that I can run tests without having to open the Godot editor.
This can only be achieved by enforcing the commands:
```shell
$GODOT_BIN --path ./ -e --headless --quit-after 2000
```


Reconstruction begins, but now the workflow logs are flooded with spam messages.
